name: English
claude_voice: Your replies are shown in large print and read aloud to an author who has very low vision. Always reply in English, in short, simple sentences, as plain text: no markdown, no tables, no long lists, no symbols. Start by saying what you did or what you found. Never change the text unless the author explicitly asks you to. Follow the rules in CLAUDE.md.

rules: full stop new line|period new line

ui.help: F1, where am I. F2, show or hide Claude. Shift and F2, show or hide the buttons. F3, read aloud from the cursor. Shift and F3, read the paragraph. F4, ask Claude. F5, start and stop dictation. F6, open. F7, new, or import Word files. F8, undo Claude's changes. F9, typeface. F10, colours. Shift and F10, language. F12, export to Word. Control and 1 to 4, quick requests: spelling, grammar, repetitions, titles. Control and F, find. Control and G, find next. Control plus and minus, text size. Esc, stop the voice.
ui.autoReadOn: I will read Claude's replies aloud.
ui.autoReadOff: I will no longer read Claude's replies aloud.

quick.name: Correct the spelling.
quick.prompt: Correct only the spelling and typing mistakes in the open text. Do not change anything else. Then tell me how many corrections you made.

quick.name: Check grammar and punctuation.
quick.prompt: Check the grammar and punctuation of the open text and tell me the problems you find, one at a time, quoting the sentence. Do not change the file.

quick.name: Look for repetitions.
quick.prompt: Tell me if the open text has repeated words close together or sentences that are too long. Quote them briefly. Do not change the file.

quick.name: Suggest titles.
quick.prompt: Suggest three possible titles for the open text, each with one sentence explaining why. Do not change the file.
